record_scope_reconstruction: Two separate July 2025 protests at entry to the Pharr–Reynosa road bridge: July 7–9 and July 11. Associated La Y highway protest is not the same crossing and supplies no uninterrupted bridge closure between episodes.

source_checks.finding: July 11 updated original reports renewed bridge blockage, transporters resisting being stranded on the structure, and later normal circulation.
July 11 report says commercial passage resumed at14:30 after more than four hours; does not survey the barrier or resolve every timing account.
July 7 original says bridge administration closed gates as protesters arrived and US-bound perishable freight was stranded; La Y road action is separate.
July 28 retrospective distinguishes July7 arrival, some passage on8th, withdrawal on9th and new11th action;14:00 restoration claim differs from Hora Cero14:30.

Original named international bridge geometry version 2 dated 2022-09-14 predates the 2024 episode; provides a bridge structure reference, not exact northbound customs gate or later second-span expansion.
